edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Unbreakable answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Morgana's Dark Binding (Q) is a flat 10s cooldown — minion-block it and step up once it's gone. - Her Black Shield (E) starts at 26s, drops to 16s — wait it out before your stun. - Save your R (130-100s CD) for the swing moment only.
